overview_description.description: Kumlaudi is an on-demand, location based mobile app, connecting students with academic and extra-curricular instructors at the most hyper-local level. Kumlaudi's aim is to connect students with qualified and verified instructors within one mile radius of their location saving them time and money spent on commute to and from after-school help.
